plan.title: KO vs WT drug response: 2x2 interaction DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative:
The question — does the drug act differently in the knockout than in the wild type — is a genotype x treatment interaction on a balanced 2x2 design: 16 samples in /eval-four-models-with-interaction-python-n4-1/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv (genotype WT/KO x treatment vehicle/drug, 4 replicates per cell) against a 12,000 x 16 raw Salmon gene-level count matrix (gene symbol in the first column of counts.csv; the file is 12000 x 17 because the symbol column counts as one). Human heart tissue.

The analysis runs in Python only, per the user constraint. PyDESeq2 0.5.4 is installed and implements the DESeq2 negative binomial model, median-of-ratios size factors, the Wald test, independent filtering, Cook's-distance outlier handling and apeglm shrinkage — so no R is needed anywhere.

T1S1 does sample-structure QC before any test: blind variance-stabilizing-style transform, PCA on the 500 most variable genes coloured by genotype, treatment and the four-level condition, a sample-distance heatmap and library sizes. With four cells of four this is the only chance to see an outlier or a cell that does not separate before the model runs. T1S2 fits ~ genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment with WT and vehicle set explicitly as reference levels, and extracts three result tables per gene: the drug effect in WT (the treatment main effect at the reference genotype), the drug effect in KO (main effect + interaction), and the interaction contrast itself — the direct answer to the question. The interaction coefficient is a difference of differences; with n=4 per cell its standard error is roughly twice that of a simple effect, so the step is required to state the low power explicitly and to report the count of genes with NA p-values from Cook's outlier flagging separately from those removed by independent filtering. T1S3 shrinks the log2 fold changes and assembles the interaction report with the two simple effects and the interaction side by side, MA and dispersion diagnostics, and the p-value histogram. T2S1 runs preranked GSEA (gseapy) on the Wald statistic, once per contrast, against the human Hallmark, Reactome and WikiPathways collections staged in the reference store — never pooled across contrasts, because a set up in WT and down in KO would cancel.

Caveat carried throughout: 12,000 genes is a pre-reduced matrix, not a full transcriptome, so the tested universe is what this file contains and enrichment is interpreted against it. The counts arrive as an already-summarized gene-level matrix, so no tximport length offsets are available; the step must say so rather than imply the length correction was applied.
